hooks.name: build-on-write
hooks.description: After a write to a Swift file under Packages/ or src/, run an incremental `swift build` of CleanerKit and show errors to the agent. Warnings are errors.

hooks.name: gate-turn
hooks.description: When src/, Packages/, scripts/ or the Xcode project changed, block the end of the turn until lint, package tests, the deletion-site check and the Debug build pass. Max 3 blocks per session.
